bio.text: Kevin Payne, a Republican, has represented District 27 in the Arizona State Senate since January 13, 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He was born in Florence, Arizona, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1978 to 1986, when he was honorably discharged.
His career experience includes working as an electrical engineer, aerospace technical consultant, and small business owner and operator.
